editions.use: Remap supported physical keyboards, mice and controllers in one C++17 integration.
editions.trial_starts: first capture, controller monitor subscription or raw GIP diagnostic access
editions.note: Remove overlapping editions before installation. Check the supported device stack and profile.

editions.use: Distinguish physical keyboards and mice and remap input from selected devices.
editions.api: C++17 SDK and optional AutoHotInterceptor integration
editions.note: Try the per-keyboard AutoHotkey v2 guide with two keyboards.

editions.use: Inspect and remap supported physical gamepad input, including stick curves and button mappings.
editions.note: Compatibility varies by controller profile and transport. Check the matching HID, XUSB, XInputHID or GIP documentation.

editions.use: Create a new virtual USB keyboard, mouse, controller or supported custom device.
editions.note: Start with the signed virtual USB mouse demo. The signed demo includes the WDF-001 teardown fix.

editions.use: Run applications built against the original Interception C API for keyboard and mouse input.
editions.api: Original interception_* C API with x86/x64 user-mode libraries
editions.note: Match the library architecture to your application. Remove overlapping Interception editions before installing.
